answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 50371 Country: India Title: To teach Quran Question: My sister is aalima, & she is going to start to teach the Quran to the ladies at home. Alhamdulillah Allah has given us everything, we don't have any need of money, but some people said to take money like 100 rupees per month for teaching Quran so that people have the importance of it. In this case, please suggest what we need to do? Have we to take money or teach free of cost? Answer ID: 50371 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 254/204/D=03/1435) In itself it is lawful to teach the holy Quran and take the remuneration. However, it is better to teach it without fee but the problem is that people would not take it seriously and the children and their family shall pay less attention. Thus it is alright to charge some fees. However, you should also have the provision to keep the poor students exempted from fee. When you collect the money and you do not need it then you should use it in charity and other good deeds. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
